fusions.name: Swallowed Whole
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health. Your tongue snaps out at the first enemy within 4 tiles and deals 20 damage, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction the target carries (max 40%).

fusions.name: Weeping Skin
fusions.desc: Sweats toxin through your skin that deals 24 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, ignoring their resistances, and leaves each [Exposed] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Gone at a Glance
fusions.desc: For 3 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you, and you spring 3 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Toxin on the Tongue
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on that enemy, up to 4. At 4 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (136% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
